title: Award History Records of Free Night Awards in the Member Account
content:
Every application, release, use and loss of one of the Free Night Awards leaves one history record naming the award, the reservation and the night, so that the award's past holds remain visible after it is released and reapplied. A history record is written only together with the award change it records.

## Kinds of history record

| Record | Written when | Names | Reason it carries |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hold record (hold entry) | The award is applied to a reservation night | The award, the reservation, the night | Applied to a reservation |
| Release record (return entry) | The award is released back to the member's account | The award, the reservation, the night | See the clauses below |
| Use record | The award is used up at check-in | The award, the reservation, the night | Stay completed |
| Loss record (loss entry) | The award is forfeited | The award, the reservation and night where the award was applied | See the clauses below |

A loss record of an award forfeited on the closure of the membership names no reservation and no night.

## Clauses on prices and reasons

**H1 (no longer in force).** The former clause under which a hold record carried the standard-room points price of the night and the top-off points, and the later release, use or loss records repeated the points price recorded on the hold, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for the price each record states.

**H2 (no longer in force).** The former clause under which a release record carried the reason cancelled before the deadline or reservation relocated, a loss record the reason cancelled after the deadline, no-show or membership closed, and a use record the reason stay completed, is no longer in force. It has been superseded by the current basis for the reason each record carries.

**H3 (in force).** A history record is written only together with the award change it records: no hold, release, use or loss record stands without the matching change of the award.

### Example (hypothetical award history)

A hypothetical award is applied to a night in May, released when that reservation is relocated, and applied again to a night in July. Its history then holds a hold record for the May night, a release record for the May night and a hold record for the July night, each naming its reservation and night; the May hold stays visible after the award has been reapplied.

superseded_clauses: A hold record carries the standard-room points price of the night and the top-off points, and the later release, use or loss records repeat the points price recorded on the hold.
A release record carries cancelled_before_deadline or reservation_relocated, a loss record cancelled_after_deadline, no_show or membership_closed, and a use record stay_completed.
